stories.title: Major Russian grain export terminals hit in Ukraine Black Sea port attack
stories.body: Grain exports from both Russia and Ukraine are falling as both countries attack each other's shipping facilities and ports.

stories.title: Israeli settlers besieging Palestinian families in West Bank village
stories.body: Israeli security forces have reportedly withdrawn and about a dozen settlers are said to remain at the site where two families have been besieged since Sunday.

stories.title: US immigration officers to be equipped with gloves that deliver electric shocks
stories.body: The US immigration agency is buying enforcement officers and agents $20m worth of gloves, which the maker says are safe when properly used.

stories.title: Trump says White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt to leave post
stories.body: Leavitt will depart from her role to spend time with her young children and family, the president says.

stories.title: Woman pulled alive from rubble 36 hours after Colombia quake
stories.body: Following a 10-hour rescue operation, emergency workers pulled the 32-year-old from beneath slabs of concrete.

stories.title: LA Lakers to be sold in record $12.5bn deal
stories.body: The Los Angeles Lakers is to be sold for a reported record $12.5bn - less than a year after Mark Walter took a majority stake in the NBA franchise.

stories.title: Thousands of Canadians call for US ambassador's expulsion
stories.body: An online petition accusing Pete Hoekstra of diplomatic interference in Canadian domestic affairs has garnered more than 60,000 signatures.

stories.title: Members of Trump's cabinet remained on decoy plane, after president's quiet exit
stories.body: Trump boarded a different plane in Turkey during a Nato summit for security reasons involving Iran.

stories.title: US inflation eases as food and fuel costs cool
stories.body: Annual US inflation dipped to 3.4% in July, with food costs slowing and housing keeping prices slightly higher.

stories.title: Danube river's low water levels reveal remains of WWII soldiers and motorcycle
stories.body: A remarkably well-preserved motorcycle and identification tags were found alongside the bodies.

stories.title: Singapore and S Korea pull Trader Joe's seasoning over poppy seeds
stories.body: Trader Joe's Everything But the Bagel seasoning contains poppy seeds which are banned in both countries.

stories.title: Zhu Rongji, who helped turn China into a trading giant, dies at 97
stories.body: The former premier brought China into the WTO and championed reforms that fuelled growth.

stories.title: Wisconsin result dents winning streak for Democratic Party's left wing
stories.body: Centrist David Crowley is projected to have beaten democratic socialist Francesca Hong, breaking a recent nationwide trend.

stories.title: At least 44 die as ferry sinks in Zimbabwe's Lake Kariba
stories.body: The vessel is said to have overturned after being hit by strong waves.

stories.title: Cristiano Ronaldo marries long-time partner Georgina Rodríguez
stories.body: The couple have tied the knot after the Portuguese captain played his last ever World Cup this summer.

stories.title: Tata Group Chairman N Chandrasekaran to step down in February
stories.body: Chandrasekaran said he would not seek reappointment when his term ends due to a lack of support from the Tata Sons board.

stories.title: US says helicopter fired missiles to disable ship breaking Iran blockade
stories.body: US Central Command says its helicopter hit the engine room of a Panama-flagged cargo vessel in the Gulf of Oman.

stories.title: Lebanon parliament votes to abolish death penalty
stories.body: The new law - which next goes to the cabinet for approval - would make Lebanon the first country in the Middle East to end capital punishment.

stories.title: Bondi Beach shooting hero's assault charges dropped by police
stories.body: Police charged Ahmed al Ahmed in June after an alleged incident with his father at a Sydney home.

stories.title: New Zealand PM survives second leadership challenge ahead of election
stories.body: Christopher Luxon says he has "full support" of his party, after a vote of confidence 12 weeks before a general election.

In Colombia, the earthquake response may prompt renewed focus on disaster preparedness in vulnerable regions. Meanwhile, economic signals like the Lakers' sale and US inflation trends should be monitored for their potential to influence broader market confidence.

Today's cautious mood reflects a world navigating incremental progress amid persistent uncertainty. The interplay between governance, resilience, and economic stability will remain critical to watch in the coming weeks.
